title: Adapter interface, local config and leg cache
goal: Providers are swappable and legs are fetched once
acceptance: Provider implementations run in `server/`; the key and provider choice come from git-ignored `server/config.local.json`, with a committed `server/config.example.json` without keys
Leg cache in SQLite keyed by provider, profile, from and to (pure key and lookup logic tested)
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no owner places, home address, photos, routes or API keys in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

prs.note: MapProvider adapter interface, local config without committed keys, and SQLite leg cache

effort.basis: Implemented 2026-11-26 in PR #8; verification is green CI on PR #8 and merge.
